sourceDiagnosis.toolRunningLiveRegion: Intended announcer is StatusRowContainer -> StatusRow -> WorkingPlaceholder (role=status, aria-live=polite/polite, aria-label); MessageList.tsx has no aria-live or announcer and only supplies isWorking to turn grouping (438-442). ToolPart's MinDurationShineText is visual-only and has no live semantics. ToolPart.tsx:1253-1261; MinDurationShineText.tsx:82-89; WorkingPlaceholder.tsx:233-260; StatusRow.tsx:38-43,59-71. useAssistantStatus maps shell/execute to 'running a command', unknown bash to 'using bash' (useAssistantStatus.ts:91-107,145-149); tests cover shell, not bash (useAssistantStatus.test.ts:131,140), and no test asserts the status row's live region. The observed empty [aria-live] was measured 400 ms after approval, inside WorkingPlaceholder's 1200 ms STATUS_DISPLAY_TIME_MS debounce; when isWorking turns false it clears displayedText, and StatusRow returns null when !isWorking or suppresses the placeholder when abortActive. That observation is therefore inconclusive, not a confirmed persistent gap. Intended announcer remains StatusRow/WorkingPlaceholder; a post-1200 ms read or source test is required before claiming failure.
sourceDiagnosis.toolRunningOwnerAndFix: Owner: packages/ui/src/components/chat/StatusRow.tsx + StatusRowContainer.tsx + packages/ui/src/hooks/useAssistantStatus.ts. Smallest fix: keep ToolPart visual-only, but ensure WorkingPlaceholder is mounted and gets the running tool phrase while canonical runtime status is running (investigate stale abortActive/isWorking or statusText suppression); add a regression test for a running canonical bash part asserting role=status/aria-live and 'T18 Fixture is using bash' (or add bash to TOOL_BUCKETS if 'running a command' is desired).
sourceDiagnosis.nativeChildFailure: Initial fixture observation (preserved): task input agent=scout/name=t18-child-1/task='Return the T18 child marker.'; child model t18fixture/t18-fixture returned plain 'Packaged write completed.' without yield and exited after reminders; parent async-result line 150 status='failed (exit 1)', error='SYSTEM WARNING: Subagent exited without calling yield tool after 3 reminders.' The inline 'completed: subagent yielded successfully' is a static spawn-feedback legend (task-spawn-feedback.md) while the initial task result details say async.state='running'; source owner packages/electron/resources/agent-runtime/packages/16/src/task/index.ts:1143-1157 + prompts/tools/task-spawn-feedback.md + task-async-contract.md. Correction staged only in /tmp/task18-fixture.mjs: child prompt now returns yield {data:{marker:'T18 child marker'}}. One rerun (T18-TASK native child yield, 11:08) shows child session 01a15f01... issued that exact yield, but the tool result was 'Host policy refused the tool operation' (isError=true), so the fixture is no longer the final blocker.
sourceDiagnosis.nativeChildHostPolicy: Product gap: packages/web/server/lib/host/worker-operation-authorizer.js has no yield exemption. yield is neither nativeTool nor ask/task/provider.use, so it falls through to policy.toolRequests and is refused for a background child; child cannot submit a result. Owner: packages/web/server/lib/host/worker-operation-authorizer.js. Smallest fix: add `if (request.toolName === 'yield') return allowed;` beside ask/task (yield is an internal result submission, no machine capability), and add an authorizer test that a child yield request is allowed. This is independent of child registration/404.
sourceDiagnosis.nativeChildRoute: Product gap: childSessionId 01a15eec... is in session-references.subagents, not root references. packages/agent-service/src/sessions/registry.ts snapshot() delegates to journal() -> get() (lines 311-315, 432-435, 906-914), and get() only resolves root references, so child snapshot returns 404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND even though runtime() supports child IDs (190-203). Owner: packages/agent-service/src/sessions/registry.ts. Smallest fix: resolve childSessionId from this.subagents and serve the child session file/projection (or otherwise route child history); add a child snapshot route test.
sourceDiagnosis.nativeChildUiLink: Separate UI gap: packages/ui/src/components/chat/message/parts/ToolPart.tsx:1329 renders TaskToolSessions only when !result, so the child link disappears as soon as the task tool result exists. Owner: ToolPart.tsx TaskToolSessions condition. Smallest fix: remove !result && so subagent links render with a result; add regression test with both paired call and tool_result present. WorkStatusSubagentsSection also showed no child because UI live-session sync did not include the child; not required once the task-row link/route works.
